capabilities: Open and edit HWP/HWPX documents in the vault
Type into body text, table cells and form fields
Save as .hwp or .hwpx with backups and re-parse checks
Embed read-only page previews and link to pages or paragraphs
Expose a revision-checked document API and AI agent tools
disambiguation: Not a handwriting or stylus tool; it opens and edits Hangul word-processor documents.
extras: Desktop only. The bundled RHWP engine is built from RHWP 0.9.0 with local patches and its SHA-256 is checked before it starts; the plugin makes no network requests. AI agent editing and save tools are off by default and must be enabled in settings and approved in the host.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit Hangul HWP/HWPX documents, so they sit in the vault as files that cannot be read or changed.

relations.evidence: Verbex is currently the only agent host that implements agentinterop v1

summary: Editor for Hangul HWP and HWPX documents that opens, edits and saves them locally with a bundled WebAssembly engine.
